parsed.answer: Yes, you're eligible for a credit. Parcel NW1001 was an Express shipment promised by 3 November and was delivered on 5 November, so it arrived late. Late Express shipments receive a credit of 100% of the shipping fee. The credit is applied to your account within 7 days and is not paid out in cash. I don't have the shipping fee amount in your account details, so I can't tell you the exact figure. The credit does not apply if the delay was caused by severe weather or by an incorrect address that you supplied.
